title: personal-threat-monitor footprint.json
description: The contract for personal-monitor/<YYYY-MM-DD>/footprint.json, the structured output of Check A. It exists so consecutive runs can be compared by scripts/Compare-Footprint.ps1 instead of by the model. A finding's id is its category plus its source (for example 'broker:spokeo'), never the run date, so the same exposure carries the same id every week. A finding that was looked for and is gone is kept with status 'removed'; one that was not looked at this run is kept with status 'untested'. Dropping a finding from the file does not mean it was fixed: Compare-Footprint reports a dropped id as not_reassessed. This document is the reference; the check that runs is the hand-written validator in scripts/FootprintSchema.ps1 (Windows PowerShell 5.1 has no Test-Json), and tests/Test-CompareFootprint.ps1 fails if the two disagree on the id pattern or the enums.

schema_version.description: Always 1. A change to this contract bumps it.

run_date.description: The run's date, matching its folder name.

notes.description: Free text about the run as a whole (sources that were down, consent not given). Never read by the diff.

id.description: category:source. Stable across runs and unique within a file. Never derived from the run date.

category.description: The source category from references/osint-sources.md, for example broker, breach, paste, social, forum, code, records, search, image.

source.description: A stable key for the source: a broker or site name, or a breach's domain, for example spokeo or example.com.

severity.description: The digest's gate: page (act now), nudge (act this week), log (record only). Never free text.

confidence.description: Per references/verification.md. An unverified common-name hit is ambiguous.

status.description: open: present this run. removed: looked for this run and gone. untested: not looked at this run.

summary.description: What is exposed, in a sentence.

exposed.description: The kinds of data exposed (address, phone, relatives, ...), not the data itself.

removal_action.description: The opt-out or removal step from references/broker-optout.md.

first_seen.description: The run_date the id first appeared.

evidence.description: Where the run log records the evidence. Never the exposed data.
